name: Callovosaurus
sum: A basal iguanodontian from the Middle Jurassic Oxford Clay of England, known from most of a left thigh bone.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: NHMUK PV R 1993, a nearly complete left femur described by Lydekker in 1889 as Camptosaurus leedsi.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Galton 1980

images.artist: The Trustees of the Natural History Museum, London
images.caption: Femur of Callovosaurus leedsi
